0:
...A lot's happened, but out of all the
scattered Cards, there's just the last one
left, huh.
1:
Looking back... it feels like I always got
dragged in and had a terrible time.
2:
Couldn't the last one at least wrap itself
up somewhere that has nothing to do with
me...?
3:
...I'm hungry. Instead of lazing around in my
room, guess I'll head downstairs for lunch.
5: Oh. Good of you to come, Tomoki.
7:
...Um, Sugata-senpai. Wasn't something off
about me just now?
8: ...? I don't quite follow what you mean.
9:
More importantly, good of you to come,
Tomoki. I was just wanting an assistant.
10:
Rushing over at this exact moment...
You're every bit the man I took you for.
11:
...No, hold on a second. Why are you
carrying on like this is normal?
12:
I don't really get it either, but... this is
obviously weird!
13:
I was in my own room until just now, you
know? Why am I here now?
14:
You came to see me, didn't you? I see
nothing strange about that.
15:
No, no! It's totally weird! I opened my
bedroom door and I was HERE?!
16:
And I don't mean some scene that skips the
travel--outside the door was literally right
here...!
17:
Routine actions are performed without
conscious thought, so they don't stay in
memory. That's hardly unusual.
18:
Which means coming to me was that natural,
everyday an act for you. That must be it.
19:
No, that is absolutely not it. I wouldn't
come to a place like this without a
reason--actually, not even WITH one.
20:
Yet you arrived here awfully eager for
that.
21:
You came in such a hurry, it looked almost
as if you'd teleported.
22:
That's already weird right there! How could
anyone possibly mistake something like
that?!
23:
Any way you slice it, I actually got
teleported from my room to here!
24:
...No. Your overflowing enthusiasm caused
me to see an illusion. That is how this
should be interpreted.
29:
That is the outfit of my first assistant.
Your enthusiasm, coming here dressed like
that--it pleases me.
30:
No! I don't remember putting these clothes
on! And between this and the teleporting,
this is way too weird!
31:
Anyone can see this is the Card's doing!
The seventh one!
32:
The seventh Card? ...I have no idea what
you mean.
33:
That thing glowing in your hand! Stop making
such obnoxious wishes!
34:
True, I found this Card over there a little
while ago... but that has nothing to do with
you volunteering as my assistant.
35:
Like hell it doesn't! That's way too much of
a stretch!
36:
What an odd thing to say. There is no
stretch anywhere.
37:
Every person yearns for the New World.
You have finally noticed its allure, too.
...It's perfectly natural, is it not?
38:
Your premise is totally wrong! The only
person who likes the New World, not just in
Sorami Town but in the whole world, is you!
39:
Dammit, these embarrassing clothes--I'm
taking them off right now...
40:
Come to think of it, that outfit is the same
one my third assistant, Mikako, wore.
42:
Fabric that once wrapped the President's
glamorous body is now touching my skin?!
43:
Fwoooooooh!! If I take a deep breath, I can
smell the President--!
44:
Though it only shares the design. It seems
to be a different one from what Mikako
wore.
45:
Then it doesn't smeeell! Not even a whiff
of her!!
46:
I'm taking it off! I'm definitely taking it of--
Whoa! It won't come off?!
47:
You like that outfit that much? I'll take it
as your zeal for being my assistant.
48:
It not coming off is obviously the Card's
effect too! Knock it off already!!
49:
To discover the New World, something is
still lacking. That is what I have always
believed.
50:
And that is a capable assistant. But now
that we have gained someone like you, we
have drawn much closer to the New World.
51:
Now, as a member of the New World
Discovery Club, and as my assistant, let us
strive for the New World together!
52:
Nooooooo!! And besides, I'm not even a club
member!
53:
...Come to think of it, as I said earlier, you
came at the perfect time.
54:
I had been thinking of trying a different
approach than before to reach the New
World.
55:
And the prototype for it has only just
been completed.
57:
It's no wonder you'd mistake it for one. The
early rockets were developed using missile
technology, after all.
58:
No, it's way past that, that's a missile!
There's a part that looks exactly like a
warhead!
59:
And it's not like a rocket would be okay
either! You haven't even thought about
landing, have you?!
60:
I will be observing the flight and collecting
data, so I needed someone else to be the
pilot...
61:
Dammit, this is the worst Card of all seven.
When does this thing wear off?!
62:
Ikaros! Nymph! Even Astraea, I don't care,
somebody help meeee!
65:
...That was a magnificent flight. As
expected of Tomoki.
66:
Someday, when I open the door to the New
World, I will be glad that the assistant at my
side is you...
67:
...Don't wrap it up all nice like that! I'll be
dead before then! Actually, I almost died
just now!
68: G-Give me back my peaceful days~~~!
